title: AFRIDOC-MT: Document-level MT Corpus for African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking machine translation performance (using BLEU, chrF, and human evaluation), analyzing generation errors (such as off-target language hallucinations and over-generation), and assessing the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) across English and five low-resource African languages to highlight English-centric disparities in model capabilities.
